paragraphs.text: Theorix is the School of Esoteric Mathematics at Hexhaven Academy on the Echoverse version of Arcavios . It is aligned and the counterpart of Quandrix . The founder of the school is Uldaros Theorix .
Uldaros Theorix founded Theorix with three magical laws:
Reality cannot be created or destroyed without sacrifice.
Leyline energy is a multiversal constant.
The dimensions of reality are defined by the minimum number of points in contact with the Blind Eternities .

Theorix mages are drawn to the impossibilities of the universe, demonstrating high intelligence, a thirst for knowledge, and a capacity for abstract thought. They achieve power over reality through theoretical math and theoretical physics. They twist the rules of reality and explore impossibilities to develop solutions to the world's problems. Cadets use impossible geometry to twist the rules of reality and conjure portals, gravity wells, and black holes. Theorix mages typically can't create realities, only transform or convert them. They've found a loophole to this law by pulling in matter from other realities, sacrificing some of their own sanity in the process. As a result of dealing with all the mind-bending physics and impossible numbers of the underlying fabric of reality, Theorix cadets tend to go insane. Possibly contributing to this phenomenon, the Theorist used the minds of Theorix cadets to store the impossibly vast map of the Multiverse he took from Loot 's mind. Void theorists specialize in abstractions, paradox magic, and portals to summon creatures from other dimensions. Theorix magic looks like geometric diagrams and ritual circles drawn in the air with the tips of one's fingers.

The Theorix campus is located near the top of the Theorist's tower and is the closest to his sanctum. The most dangerous of Hexhaven's campuses, it is not safe to spend long periods of time in certain areas of the Theorix campus. Its ever-changing architecture can create doorless rooms, and portals and gravity wells are scattered throughout. There is a shadow-draped rock garden at the outer edge of the campus where cadets practice their battle spells. At the center of the Theorix campus is the Parabox , a perfect cube of void space, eleven feet on each side. The Parabox's outer surface is black and smooth, with purple portal magic along its edges. Inside, the cube is an infinite-seeming theory-space where the manipulation of reality is contained within its walls. Mages use this space to test the most extreme mathematical theories without affecting the rest of campus. The Theorem Hall is a repository of theorems.
